import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router"
export const Route = createFileRoute("/api/auth/login")({ server: { handlers: { POST: async ({ request }) => {
	const { apiBaseUrl, authConfig, readPath, setAdminTokens } = await import("@/lib/auth/session.server")
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin")
  if (origin && origin !== new URL(request.url).origin) return Response.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
  const body: unknown = await request.json().catch(() => undefined)
  if (!body || typeof body !== "object" || Array.isArray(body)) return Response.json({ error: "Invalid credentials" }, { status: 400 })
  const values = body as Record<string, unknown>
  if (typeof values[{{FIZZYX_USERNAME_FIELD}}] !== "string" || typeof values[{{FIZZYX_PASSWORD_FIELD}}] !== "string") return Response.json({ error: "Invalid credentials" }, { status: 400 })
  if (String(values[{{FIZZYX_USERNAME_FIELD}}]).length > 320 || String(values[{{FIZZYX_PASSWORD_FIELD}}]).length > 1024) return Response.json({ error: "Invalid credentials" }, { status: 400 })
  const response = await fetch(new URL(authConfig.loginPath, apiBaseUrl()), { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json", accept: "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(values) })
  if (!response.ok) return Response.json({ error: "Invalid credentials" }, { status: 401 })
  const payload: unknown = await response.json()
  const accessToken = readPath(payload, authConfig.accessTokenPath)
  if (typeof accessToken !== "string" || !accessToken) return Response.json({ error: "Invalid credentials" }, { status: 401 })
  const refreshToken = authConfig.refreshTokenPath ? readPath(payload, authConfig.refreshTokenPath) : undefined
  setAdminTokens(accessToken, typeof refreshToken === "string" ? refreshToken : undefined)
  return Response.json({ ok: true })
} } } })
